engineering_invariants.statement: 0% Python and 0% Node in the runtime line-rate hotpath. Hotpath routing and streaming must execute 100% in Go, Rust, or WASM.

engineering_invariants.statement: Every new feature or bugfix requires a prior failing test that demonstrates the change or defect before implementation code is written.
